match.note: A finding matches an expected defect when it names the same file and a line within the window. One finding matches at most one defect.

arms.describe: Review budget and corpus as of main ced3f9f: no flow ledger, no impact, no verification, no learned rules.
Adds the spec-flow-analyzer seat, flow ledger and defect-vs-extra-scope rule.
Adds the packet impact section (reverse dependents, flow models).
Adds decision-agent verification of P1/P2 findings before the report.
Adds learned review rules from dispositions and authored misses (knowledge.feedback=suggest).

promotion.note: Arms are compared incrementally on the same model, host and budget. A change is kept when held-out recall rises without a rise in clean-control findings. Thresholds are set before the first held-out run.
